title: analyst config
description: Settings of the analyst module: thresholds of the lesson state machine and of the recurrence rule.

recompute.description: Numeric gates of the lesson state machine (analyst recompute, analyst status).

candidate_min_n.description: Observations needed to promote a lesson from ephemeral to candidate (lowered for low-activity projects).

candidate_min_conf.description: Confidence needed to promote a lesson from ephemeral to candidate.

curated_min_n.description: Observations after which a candidate is flagged as ready for curated (a person still decides).

curated_min_conf.description: Confidence after which a candidate is flagged as ready for curated.

curated_min_passrate.description: Share of passing tests after which a candidate is flagged as ready for curated.

deprecate_conf.description: Confidence below which a candidate is deprecated and a curated lesson is flagged for review.

candidate_min_n_floor.description: Lowest adaptive observation threshold for a candidate in a low-activity project.

digest.description: Recurrence rule of the digest (analyst digest).

pathology_window.description: How many of the latest project runs are inspected for a recurring run pathology.

pathology_min_hits.description: In how many runs of the window a pathology code must occur to become a lesson.
